notes.title: KEYBIND REBINDING SUPPORT!
notes.notes:
You should now be able to set your own keybinds for most things in the in-game menu -> controls. 
It should also save the keybinds, and re-load the previously saved keybinds when relaunching the game. 

The only non-rebindable keybinds now should be:
Left click (action, shooting, etc.)
Escape (menu, quit, generic escape stuff)
Spacebar (jump)
T (talk to npcs)
Q-E (drop-pickup weapons)
F (various interactions with the world)
Maybe some other generic ones

I will eventually make those rebindable too, especially for possible controller support, but for now every other keybind should be rebindable in that menu mentioned at the beginning of this post.

My apologies for making this a feature so late lol, it actually ended up being a lot easier than I thought it would with Unity's default Input System.

IF you run into problems with it, as I have only tested it myself so far and found no issues but ya never know, then old_stable_3 game version is the fallback version. Also let me know of any bugs with it.

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 4
notes.notes:
Few more cool additions today for the beta:

Trenchbroom custom maps changes:

-Teleporter point entities are now available in Trenchbroom. To link two teleporter, all you have to do is place down two teleporter point entities in your Trenchbroom map and give them the same tpID number. Please don't use numbers less than 10 as I am already using those in other parts of the game x)

-Purchasable walls are now also available in Trenchbroom as brush entities. To use them do the following: create a brush on your map of the size and texture you want the purchasable wall/door to be. Then right click -> Create Brush Entity -> func -> purchasable wall. Then set the price to a different number if you want (default is 10,000 buckarinos)


In-game changes:

-The Original (super shotty) now penetrates enemies! Wow! 

-You can now also shotgun-jump with The Original! I love UBERSLAUGHTER realism it's just like real life!



IMPORTANT REMINDER: When you first start the Beta make sure to select at least two maps in the MAPS section of the Main Menu. I'm working on making all the in-built maps enabled by default. It sounds like it shouldn't be that hard but my five overworked braincells have been struggling to fix it.

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 3
notes.notes:
Another small update today:

-The rotations of point entities in trenchbroom not working are now fixed. Meaning that the little arrow indicator on point entities now actually represents the direction that the entity is facing.

-**IMPORTANT!!** UBERSLAUGHTER Trenchbroom maps are now 1:1 scale with Quake 1 maps. The height of the player is now around z:60. This should make it easier for you guys to make custom maps if you already have experience mapping for Quake. 
This means that the part of the tutorial that says that player height reference should be z:400 is now obsolete! (I will have to make an updated tutorial anyways)

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 2 - CUSTOM MAPS/STEAM WORKSHOP
notes.notes:
Two additions to the custom maps logic today!

-Added destroyable doors/walls/anything you want. Right click a brush and go into brush entities and select destroyable. 
-Added lava. Same thing as above, make a brush and right click it and select Lava in brush entities. Then you can change the damage and damage tick interval in the entity properties.







Known issues:
-When applying in-built textures to a mesh and running the map, sometimes the mesh will just decide to use another in-built texture for whatever reason. Working on a fix! Custom textures should be working fine though.
-Unity has a maximum of 8 light sources per object. Meaning that if 8 lights are already reaching an object, any subsequent light after those 8 will not be displayed. There is no easy way for me to fix it as far as I know, but an easy workaround I have found is to reduce the light range or have more brushes/meshes in the scene. So instead of having one big wall, you could cut it up into smaller wall pieces.
-There is no easy way to tell which way the mystery box, perk machine and other stuff are facing, which is annoying. Unless there is so way for trenchbroom to show local axis for entities, I will work on a fix for that too.



While I work on those issues, I will also work on adding doors, adding back the teleporters, custom skyboxes and purchasable doors/walls.

notes.title: UBERSLAUGHTER Beta Update
notes.notes:
Okay so I've made a few changes to the Beta Build, which is the build you'd use to make custom maps and upload or play steam workshop custom maps. 

Here are some of the changes:

-The main menu now has a "Maps" button which takes you to the maps list. This maps list allows to you to select which maps you want to play and unselect the ones you don't like. This list includes the official levels which are the following (I will name them appropriately in the future):
                 "1" --> starter map
                 "3-1" --> desert map
                 "5" --> underground+outside area map
                 "6" --> blood arena map
                 "8" --> blue circular arena map
                 "9" --> aztec pyramids jungle map

So you can basically disable the official maps that you don't like, which is kinda neat!
The maps list also works with custom maps, which should show up in the list. Now keep in mind this is still a beta, so I really appreciate any feedback on any bugs/problems you may encounter!

-The Trenchbroom API now has icons and such for different point entities. There are also properties for the light source entities, such as light intensity and light range and even light color! Another point entity property is the jumpPad jump force. So now you can set your own jumpForce for any jumpPad you drag into your Trenchbroom map!

-I will add more of these properties and entities in the upcoming days. Here are some that I have planned for: custom skyboxes, placing down water/lava, make certain meshes/brushes be destroyable with kick/punches (think of kicking down doors for example). More than just those will come as well!


As always I am available to chat about bugs/features on both discord and in the steam discussions/community hub, don't hesitate to reach out!

notes.title: 5/20/2024 PATCH
notes.notes:
Okay for this one I fixed a bunch of minor and ergonomics stuff

-The whole crosshair + custom crosshairs settings now should properly save when restarting game. The open crosshair folder button also should be working

-You can now disable/enable fps in the video settings menu, it should also save when exiting game

-Pixelation, gamma, post exposure and contrast should save when exiting game. Also added a reset default button as those settings can get out of hand quickly and are fairly sensitive

-I got some reports that the IRS round was bugging out when leaving the intermission area. I think it should be fixed now

Some more updates coming through soon!

notes.title: DAY-THREE PATCH ONE
notes.notes:
This one is a little shorter. I spent way too much time trying to fix the Aliens that would randomly stop moving forever, ended up removing the repositioning mechanic for now, and they now slide while shooting (surely that's intended...). I'll spend more time on it later.

Here are the other fixes:

-The IRS mechanic was a bit too overwhelming so I toned it down.
-All slot machine outputs should now give money. Sometimes the yield is so low it would round to 0. But now it gives you one whole dollar!! But I also buffed the yield of some of the lower combinations. I think that might make the slot machines too rewarding but we shall see...
-Buffed the Butt Blaster 9000
-Buffed Kyro Blade damage
-Re-buffed the Lobotomizers, including the upgraded Lobotomizers

Tomorrow I will be working on a little Big Baz rework eh!

notes.title: DAY-TWO PATCH ONE
notes.notes:
This one is a bit heftier, a few changes that I hope I have implemented correctly. I have tested them but you never know...

-Fixed the money in the billions going negative from the stock market
-Lava tubes map has increased number of pickup locations (the hp, ammo, testosterone pickups)
-Small arena map with the statues now has its lava dealing way less damage, so you don't get one-shot if you drop into it
-Every enemy should now give testosterone. Testosterone gained is still based on distance to the enemy, keep in mind
-Reroll button for leveling now has a different sound playing when the player doesn't have enough money to afford it
-Stock market values now stabilized 5 times faster than before. It is still possible to abuse the stock market, it just needs a lot more commitment, only true sigma males will achieve such financial gains now
-Added a slider for max active enemies in the in-game setting menu. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK AS IT CAN CAUSE PERFORMANCE ISSUES WHEN SETTING IT TO HIGH VALUE!
-Every enemy now scales (some didn't previously) based on round number. They also scale much faster than previously, and there are less total enemies generated per round so rounds should go faster
-Brutus and redacted guns now both scale with weapon damage level-up, they didn't before
-Big Baz now has scaling too!
-Fixed minigun spin sound playing when reloading
-The original (shotgun) upgraded variant sucked, as it didnt scale on-hit like its original counterpart. Therefore I have made the green mega shotty have one upgraded variant, and the original now has no upgraded variants. This is just for now, as I'm brainstorming what I want the upgraded variant for The Original shotgun to be. 


//NEW MECHANIC//

For you guys who immediately went for the turbo-oligarch grindset (you know who you are), stacking share prices of millions and up, I have added a counter mechanic. I won't spoil too much what it is, but let's just say you would be finding out what the IRS looks like in UBERSLAUGHTER if you turbo-abuse the stock market...


I have a few more fixes coming up either later today or tomorrow. 

Special thanks to Soko for reporting a lot of these issues
